content_sections.heading: Akashvani Delhi Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notification does not mention the total number of vacancies. Applications are invited to form a casual panel for the following posts: Casual News Editor (Hindi) Casual News Reader-cum-Translator (Hindi)

content_sections.heading: Akashvani Delhi Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must be of Indian origin and residents of Delhi and NCR.

rows.qualification_required: Graduation from a recognised university; and a degree in Journalism (Hindi) or PG Diploma in Journalism (Hindi)/Mass Communication from a recognised university/institution with at least one year duration; or 5 years experience of reporting/editing work in print/electronic media. Proficiency in Hindi language. Desirable: Experience of journalism work in radio/TV/print in a reputed media organisation; and knowledge of basic computer application and typing in Hindi.

Graduation from a recognised university. Proficiency in Hindi language. Powerful voice and good presentation skills. Desirable: Experience of journalism in radio/TV/print; and knowledge of basic computer application and Hindi typing.

content_sections.heading: Akashvani Delhi Age Limit
content_sections.text: Candidates must be between 21 years of age and not more than 50 years of age.

content_sections.heading: Akashvani Delhi Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee must be paid through a demand draft in favour of PB:DG (News), NSD, AIR, New Delhi or online to State Bank of India, Parliament Street, New Delhi branch, Account Number: 11084233458, IFSC Code: SBIN0070691 (UTR details must be attached with the application). The fee is non-refundable.

content_sections.heading: Akashvani Delhi Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process includes a written exam followed by a second stage consisting of an interview or voice test depending on the post. Selection comprises two stages: (1) Written exam (2) Interview. The written exam carries 50 or more marks to assess professional ability and knowledge, and has a duration of three hours. Candidates scoring 50 or more marks in the written exam will be called for an interview. The Selection Committee will assess overall personality and suitability for radio news. Final inclusion in the panel requires approval from Director General (News). Selection comprises two stages: (1) Written exam (2) Voice test and interview in the relevant language. The test carries 100 marks and a three-hour duration. Candidates scoring 50 or more marks in the written exam will be called for the voice test to test voice quality, modulation, delivery style, pronunciation, and accent. The Selection Committee may recommend candidates scoring 50 or more marks in the voice test and interview for approval by Director General (News).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Akashvani Delhi
content_sections.text: Download the official notification and application form from the official website. Fill out the prescribed proforma with accurate details. Attach a passport-size photograph on the designated space of the form. Enclose self-attested copies of educational certificates, mark sheets, category certificates, and experience certificates. Attach the original bank draft or online UTR details as proof of application fee payment. If working in government/autonomous bodies, enclose a "No Objection Certificate" (NOC) from the employer. Write the envelope title as: "समाचार सेवा विभाग आकाशवाणी में आकस्मिक समाचार संपादक (हिंदी) और आकस्मिक समाचार वाचक-सह-अनुवादक (हिंदी) के पदों के लिए आवेदन" . Send the completed application by post or deliver it by hand to: वरिष्ठ प्रशासनिक अधिकारी, समाचार सेवा विभाग, आकाशवाणी, कमरा नंबर 221, न्यू ब्रॉडकास्टिंग हाउस, पार्लियामेंट स्ट्रीट, नई दिल्ली-110001 latest by 21.10.2026 (6:00 PM) .

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of educational qualification certificates and mark sheets Experience certificates (if any) SC/ST/OBC certificate (if applicable) Demand Draft or UTR details / online payment receipt No Objection Certificate (NOC) for government employees Passport-size photograph affixed to the application form

content_sections.heading: Akashvani Delhi Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Engagement is purely on a casual assignment basis (regulatorized) and does not confer any right to regular employment in the organization. Work will be assigned as per departmental requirements, generally not exceeding six days in a month. Incomplete applications or applications received after the last date (21.10.2026, 6:00 PM) will be summarily rejected. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the written exam, voice test, or interview. Candidates must not engage in any activity that harms the reputation of Akashvani/Prasar Bharati or affects the impartiality and accuracy of news. Candidates passing the written exam will be notified via email for the voice test or interview. The competent authority reserves the right to cancel any application without assigning reasons.

faq.question: Q1. What is Akashvani Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is an offline recruitment notification issued by Prasar Bharati, Akashvani New Delhi to engage Casual News Editors (Hindi) and Casual News Readers-cum-Translators (Hindi) on a casual assignment basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Akashvani Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The total number of vacancies is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Akashvani Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 21 October 2026 up to 6:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Casual News Editor?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a graduation degree from a recognised university along with a degree or PG diploma in Hindi Journalism/Mass Communication of at least one year duration, or 5 years of reporting/editing experience in print or electronic media, with proficiency in Hindi.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Akashvani Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 21 and 50 years of age.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹354/- for General category candidates and ₹266/- for SC/ST/OBC candidates, inclusive of GST.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for Akashvani Delhi Casual posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must fill out the prescribed offline application format, attach required documents and fee proof, and send it by post or hand delivery to the Senior Administrative Officer at NSD Akashvani, New Delhi.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any written examination for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, the selection process includes a written examination of three hours carrying 50 or more marks, followed by an interview or voice test.

faq.question: Q9. Will this casual assignment lead to a regular government job?
faq.answer: No, working on a casual assignment basis does not give any right to regular employment in the organisation.
